title: Platinum Plus Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Platinum Plus account requirements: a $50,000 initial deposit to open, a $100,000 minimum balance to maintain, and daily interest compounding. It also states the monthly withdrawal limit is -1 (no cap on the number of withdrawals).
faqs: How much is the initial deposit required to open a Platinum Plus account?
What minimum balance must I maintain on my Platinum Plus account?
Is there a monthly cap on the number of withdrawals?
When is interest on the Platinum Plus account compounded?
What happens if my balance or activity changes?
